roleDescriptions.member: Has limited control over the organization.
roleDescriptions.owner: Has full control over the organization.
roleDescriptions.personal workspace: Has full control over the personal workspace
roleDescriptions.admin: Manages people, roles, and teams. Cannot assign Owner or remove the last owner.
roleDescriptions.builder: Builds and edits flows, tools, and data. Does not manage people, roles, or teams.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Opens pages. Does not change them, and does not open server logs.
